intro.label: FACT
intro.text: Ail'Vorith is the Deep Elf starting zone (wiki level range 1-50). You start as a 'shadowless' exile who is only welcome in the Foreign Quarter; the starter quest and your class House quest earn your way into the city.

intro.label: FACT
intro.text: Switch your chat language to Deep Common (right-click the main chat window > Languages), or Deep Elf quest NPCs may not answer you.

intro.label: FACT
intro.text: The zone was in its first iteration at the Deep's beta launch: 'a starter zone akin to Evershade Weald, with multiple newbie yards as well as hunting grounds ranging from level 1 to 20 plus strewn about higher level camps (up to 50)'.

intro.label: UNVERIFIED
intro.text: Community reports call Ail'Vorith the hardest of the four starts: Foreign Quarter merchants price badly until you have city access, and it is a long way from the surface hubs.

faction.label: FACT
faction.text: Ail'Vorith city guards (level 50+) are listed as 'KoS to all until you prove yourself (pending changes)'. Your starting parchment warns that entering any district past the Foreign Quarter means 'immediate extermination'. Do not cross into the inner city until your House quest grants access.

faction.label: FACT
faction.text: House Xal'tharn Part 1 rewards 'Access to the city (Update 0.30.0.0)'. Klavel Sul also warns that the city guards 'will not suffer an exile to pass the gates'.

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Forum (2026-10-11): you are KoS to the city before the House quest line. Finishing it gets you to Disdain, which lets you past the guards. Fungal armor turn-ins and killing outcasts raise you further, and 'it doesn't take long' to be able to bank and use vendors.

faction.label: FACT
faction.text: Citizens of Ail'Vorith goes up with the Fungal Armor Quests and by killing Deepgulp goblins. It goes down when you kill Deepcut bandits (Deepcut marksman, basher, miner and others, plus Jorlach the Fearless). The wiki lists the Underdocks as the zone where it can be lowered.

faction.label: FACT
faction.text: Provost Xan'shorn: 'the Houses are not in alignment. Pledging with one will earn the scorn of others.' Which House hits which is not listed: no sourced data yet.

faction.label: FACT
faction.text: Night Harbor: the wiki has no standing table for Deep Elves. Patch 0.30.2.0 (2026-09-25) says 'Night Harbor factions should now be easier to gain'.

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Night Harbor is effectively KoS for a Deep Elf. Players report seething or KoS with the Red Mantle and Steel Talon guards, Harbor guards, patrolmen and citizens. Agnostic deity did not stop the named guards. The guards at the Underdocks tunnel entrance and the Sojourners were fine.

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Underdocks: several players report it is not KoS for Deep Elves. Patch 0.30.2.0 made the relevant Underdocks NPCs speak both Common and Deep Common (that part is FACT).

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Getting out of KoS in Night Harbor is a long grind. Reports range from about 500 faction kills after the patch (hearsay) to 7-8 hours of wererats in Shaded Dunes to reach Disdain (level 18 cleric, 2026-10-04) and about 6 hours of wererats outside the Underdocks. Several players report the faction bar not moving at all (2026-10-03).

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Even with Night Harbor citizens fixed, the Bard and Rogue guilds are separate factions and stay KoS, and the North Bank's Steel Talon guards and bankers were still hostile for one player at Amicable citizens. Rats, beetles and bats in the Night Harbor graveyard reportedly raise Red Mantle quickly.

faction.label: UNVERIFIED
faction.text: Faelindral: no sourced data yet for how Faelindral treats a Deep Elf.

faction.label: STRATEGY
faction.text: Treat Night Harbor as hostile. Use the Underdocks as your surface hub, and only start a Night Harbor faction grind when you have a group or a friend to buy spells and sell loot for you (what the Reddit and forum posters did). Do not kill Deepcut bandits for Underdocks or Night Harbor rep without knowing they cost you Citizens of Ail'Vorith (wiki faction page).

travel.label: FACT
travel.text: The boat stops at docks in a cave under Ail'Vorith and runs to the Underdocks via the Great Cavern Sea and the Caves of Irem. Gate Captain Xaros stands at the last dock before leaving town.

travel.label: FACT
travel.text: You can jump off the Underdocks-Ail'Vorith boat into the Great Cavern Sea, or follow the boat's path on foot and by swimming.

travel.label: UNVERIFIED
travel.text: Before you have city access: the boat docks under the restricted side of the city. A player reached it by swimming in carefully, then rode the Underdocks elevator up toward Night Harbor (forum 2026-09-10).

travel.label: FACT
travel.text: Blind Midden (dungeon) connects to Ail'Vorith. The wiki gives a short route (through the secret wall at Cook Vashuk) and a long route (along the starter-quest tunnel).

travel.label: FACT
travel.text: Rothold (wiki level 30-45) is entered from the western edge of the Great Cavern Sea. Its teleporter NPC was disabled in 0.29.0.0.

money.label: FACT
money.text: Player-tracked coin drops in Ail'Vorith: 3-60 copper per kill, average 9 copper (1,927 kills; most players hunt there at levels 3-18, peak 17).

money.label: FACT
money.text: House Varros Supplies (repeatable, level 1): Apprentice Esveth pays 25 copper plus XP and House Varros faction per full stack of 20 Bone Chips (decayed skeletons drop them).

money.label: FACT
money.text: Deepgulp goblins drop about 5-13 copper. Cook Deepbite (14-15) shares their loot table and can drop a Crude Gatorhide Cap.

money.label: FACT
money.text: Most-gathered resources in Ail'Vorith (player counts): Copper Ore, Resin, Shroomwood, Tin Ore, Ghost Poppy, Lionleaf and Brittle Stone, with Silver Ore and chipped gems more rarely.

money.label: STRATEGY

avsq.name: Ail'Vorith Starter Quest
avsq.where: A few feet from where new Deep Elves spawn, outside the Foreign Quarter footbridge
avsq.why: Required: the Obsidian Shackle it gives unlocks every House class quest, and through them city access.
avsq.prereq: New Deep Elf character started in Ail'Vorith (you spawn holding the Imbued Parchment). Set chat language to Deep Common.
avsq.faction: No faction change listed on the wiki pages: no sourced data yet.

steps.text: Read the Imbued Parchment and hand it to Toilmaster Verith or Toilmistress Rallvessa.
Use /look crate and /take pickaxe on the crate labelled REPAIRED to get a Slave Pickaxe (the BROKEN crate's pickaxe fails and Verith slaps you for 2 damage). Hand it in; it is given back.
Go south into the water and follow the wall right to a small quarry cave. Equip the pickaxe and mine 20 Fragile Quarry Rock (nodes respawn in 5-10 seconds).
Hand in the 20 rock and the pickaxe for a Pack of Stone (you become encumbered). Carry it across the footbridge to Supplier Jul, the first building on the left in the Foreign Quarter.

Agree to make sharpening stones ('I will do it'). You get a Sharpening Stone Satchel and Recipe: Fragile Sharpening Stone (right-click to learn). Take 5-8 Fragile Quarry Rock from the crate next to Jul (/take rock).

Through the market gate, right through the tunnel, right fork, first building on the right: use the grinding wheel by Blacksmith Zorvek to make 5 Fragile Sharpening Stones. Put them in the satchel and combine.

Return the Full Sharpening Stone Satchel to Jul for the Sharpening Stone Delivery Satchel, then give it to Verith. Answer that you made them, then that you are prepared, to receive a Small Leather Hunting Satchel.

Hunt the newbie yard for 2 each: Bone Chips (a decayed skeleton), Deep Beetle Legs (a small beetle, a deep beetle), Damaged Fungus Cap (a cave sporeling). Put them in the satchel in single stacks and combine.
Hand the Filled Leather Hunting Satchel to Verith for the Satchel of Questionable Spoils. Deliver it to Cook Vashuk (inn past the courtyard fountain, back-right doorway, downstairs, kitchen).
Hail Verith, say Yes to rejoining the Houses, and take Verith's Recommendation to Provost Xan'shorn (walks in circles on the left of the courtyard).
He clasps the Obsidian Shackle on your wrist. Enter the Obsidian Academy and find your House representative (see the House quest for your class).

mobs.from: Stone Ore veins in the quarry cave (mining)
a small beetle (2-3), a deep beetle (3-4)

rewards.item: Obsidian Shackle (wrist: AC 1, HP +5, Mana +5; magic, unique, no drop)

avsq.label: FACT

xal.name: House Xal'tharn (Quest)
xal.where: Foreign Quarter: Military Outpost per the zone and NPC pages; the quest page says Obsidian Academy, back of the room with the melee instructors
xal.why: Your class House quest: chest armor at 8, city access, House Xal'tharn faction and the Iron Render weapon.
xal.prereq: Obsidian Shackle from the Ail'Vorith Starter Quest. Deep Common language.
xal.faction: Part 1 grants city access (wiki). Part 2 turn-in: 'You gain faction with House Xal'tharn'. Other faction hits are marked as unknown on the wiki: no sourced data yet.

steps.text: Part 1 (8+): hail Klavel Sul; say 'The Queen', then 'I would be a cenobite', then 'Do you have a task for me?'. You receive the Remnant Satchel (6 slots).
Swim around the west of the city, where elementals and skulls patrol the west island shores. Kill a separated skull and a spectral remnant (both 8-11) for 6 Lost Skull.
Combine the satchel and hand it to Klavel Sul (XP). Say 'I swear allegiance to the Queen!' (XP). Inquisitors receive the Dull Iron Cuirass; Monks the Simple Chestwrap.

Part 2 (13+): before 13, Klavel says you lack the skill. At 13, hail him and say 'I accept.' He gives a summons for Lady Miniel in the Shol'tar, beneath the Queen's arena: take the road on the right into the Dark City and go through the dungeon gates near the bank.

Give the summons to Miniel Ubast in the Inquisitor's Guildhall (NPC page: enter the main city, turn right, up the ramp, the prison guarded by Inquisitors, up one floor and through the door). Ask about the duty and where the exiles are.

Go to the exile camps to the south, by the river into the Great Cavern Sea: past the waterfall where snakes gather, on the bottom floor past the invisible hired thug. Kill exiles until you have one each of the Unknown, Silver and Gold Sigil of a Lesser House (unique: one of each).
Keep killing the bottom-floor exiles until Gullach Otal'qar (16-17, named Fighter) spawns in their place, then kill him for Gullach's Head.
Hand the 3 sigils and the head to Miniel Ubast.

mobs.from: a separated skull (8-11, Enchanter: Mesmerize, Silence), a spectral remnant (8-11, Fighter), west island shores

mobs.item: Sigil of a Lesser House (Unknown, Silver, Gold)
mobs.from: exiles: a starving outcast, a runaway, a praying exile (exile mobs are 15-22)
Gullach Otal'qar (16-17), bottom floor of the exile area behind the hired thug

xal.turnin: Part 1: Klavel Sul. Part 2: Miniel Ubast (Shol'tar, inside the city)

rewards.xp: XP at both Part 1 turn-ins and at the Part 2 turn-in
rewards.item: Inquisitor: Dull Iron Cuirass (chest AC 9, STA +1, INT +1, HP +5) and Iron Render (1H slash 7/30, STR +2, STA +1, INT +1, HP +5, Mana +5). Monk: Simple Chestwrap and Tarnished Iron Bo.

xal.label: FACT

notes.label: UNVERIFIED
notes.text: The Ail'Vorith Class Quests page lists a Xal'tharn Pendant as the Inquisitor reward; the quest page itself gives the Dull Iron Cuirass. The monstersandmemories.wiki copy says the Klavel Sul entry is 'probably not accurate for Early Access'.

notes.label: STRATEGY
notes.text: Do Part 2 at about 15-17, not 13: the sigil exiles are 15-22 and Gullach is 16-17 (wiki levels). Bring a group or a healer.

steps.text: Hail Leatherworker Vex, then ask 'What is something that could keep me alive longer?' and say 'I seek protection.'
Ask 'What Coat?', 'What Helm?', 'What Leggings?' or 'What Boots?' for each piece's recipe.
Coat: 3 Perfect Fungus Cap, 2 Strong Fungus Hyphea, 1 Perfect Fungus Stem. Helm: 2 Cap, 1 Hyphea. Leggings: 2 Stem, 2 Hyphea, 2 Perfect Fungus Volva. Boots: 2 Volva, 2 Hyphea.
Hand each set of parts to Vex to receive that piece (XP and faction each).

steps.text: Caves of Irem Pyramid Ruins: enthralled mercenaries, explorers, rangers and casters (~40+), an enthralled giant ~45, Baron Xio 44 (Lensed Horn Bow, Clouded Mail Gauntlets, Clear Lens Blade).

steps.label: UNVERIFIED
steps.text: Above about 45: no sourced Deep route yet (the wiki lists Vhaleth Hal'kareth, level 60, in the Great Cavern Sea as a named mob, not a camp).
